items.Sentence: The headworks includes a mechanically cleaned screen, a bypass channel with a bar screen...
The headworks includes... two cutthroat flumes to provide even flow distribution to the two aeration basins.
Secondary treatment consists of two aeration basins providing a complete mix activated sludge process using extended retention of biological solids.

Two 50-feet diameter, 16-feet side-water-depth secondary clarifiers remove the biomass associated with the secondary treatment process and produce a clarified effluent ready for disinfection and final discharge.
Secondary effluent can either flow by gravity or be pumped to the chlorine contact basins where chlorine solution is used to achieve disinfection and sulfur dioxide solution is used to dechlorinate.
Solids handling consists of pumping WAS from the secondary clarifiers to a biosolids storage basin.
